title: A button for your tribute room's TV
summary: The stand under your tribute room's TV now has a button. Press it to move the TV on to the next screen, and from the last screen it takes you back to your perks. The last screen also has a star at the top that opens your perks again.
highlights: Press the button under the TV for the next screen
From the last screen it goes back to your perks
A star on the last screen opens your perks
